LGBTQSource: HRC Municipal Equality Index 2024 (Cedar Rapids scored 100/100); Movement Advancement Project Iowa state profile.
Description: Cedar Rapids is an eastern Iowa city along the Cedar River and a nationally significant defense electronics and avionics cluster anchored by Collins Aerospace. Retirees benefit from affordable housing with typical home values around $215k, low cost of living, an in-city VA outpatient clinic, Walmart access, Iowa's full state exemption of military retirement pay, and a top-tier municipal equality score. Tradeoffs include cold, snowy Midwestern winters with roughly 31 inches of snow, lack of a local Costco (closest is Coralville ~22 mi south), and property crime running above the national average.
